verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's developer portal serves a valid llms.txt (HTTP 200, descriptive content) that an agent could use to discover CUDA/GPU-related docs, but this is at the general developer.nvidia.com domain rather than an RTX-5090-specific surface, and adjacent agent-friendly affordances (markdown doc exports, OpenAPI spec) are absent (404s). missing for 10: RTX-5090-specific llms.txt or agent doc entry point, working markdown/API exports, independent confirmation agents actually use this pathway successfully.
